headline: Banca Transilvania Group Posts Net Profit of RON 3.85 Billion for 9M 2026
summary: Banca Transilvania Group reported a consolidated net profit of RON 3.85 billion ($830 million) for the first nine months of 2026.
why: Banca Transilvania is the largest financial services institution operating in Romania.
